nodes.title: Wing part masses (CAD estimate)
nodes.text: Declared mass of every wing instance node in subsystems/wing/interfaces.json: WNG-001, WNG-002, WNG-003, WNG-004-R, WNG-004-L, WNG-005-R, WNG-005-L, WNG-011-R, WNG-011-L, WNG-012-R, WNG-012-L, WNG-020
nodes.basis: team/D1/wing_data.py: XPS volume x 30 kg/m3, tape arc length x 0.065 kg/m2, spar 0.102 kg/m, C2 plug and slot-fill masses

nodes.title: Wing part CG x (CAD)
nodes.text: CG x of every wing instance node, same order as ASM-D1-PART-MASSES
nodes.basis: subsystems/wing/interfaces.json cg_xyz_m (CAD volume centroids, tape by area)

nodes.title: Elevon end gap
nodes.text: Gap at each end of each panel to the core cut-out (hot-wire kerf)

nodes.title: Wing CAD read-outs
nodes.text: [min foam over the closed spar bore, wall from the aft ESC groove to the spar slot, deepest groove / local thickness, foam over the servo pocket ceiling, lower-bevel clearance to the core at full down, at full up] (m, -)
nodes.basis: subsystems/wing/fusion/wing.py#layout() via team/D1/wing_data.py#readouts (S5010, params, fins / pod / harness params)

nodes.title: Foam + skin over D6's torque-tube groove
nodes.text: Upper skin height minus the groove ceiling at the groove walls

nodes.title: Servo pocket bond surface
nodes.text: Floor + four walls of one servo pocket (bare foam the D6 frame bonds to)

nodes.title: Spar bore bond area
nodes.text: Bore surface in contact with the slot fill over both half-spans (open windows and pockets excluded)

nodes.title: Pod recess cut
nodes.text: Recess front x (upper skin = pod base), aft x, max depth, foam left under the floor at the aft end

nodes.title: Wing surface outside the upper prop keep-outs (CAD)
nodes.text: Lower bound of the gap from the core and tape surfaces to KO-PROP-UR/UL (keep-out radius already includes requirements.prop_clearance_min_m)
nodes.basis: team/D1/wing_claims.py#_prop_gap: all modules stub-built, wing section polygons sampled densely against the canted keep-out cylinders registered by subsystems/propulsion/fusion/propulsion.py

nodes.title: prop gap
nodes.equation: gap = min over sampled wing surface points of max(|a| - half, rad - R) to each KO-PROP-U*

nodes.title: mass
nodes.equation: wing mass = sum of the CAD part masses; CG x = sum(m x) / sum(m)

nodes.title: elevon
nodes.equation: frac = 2 sum(span_i - 2 gap) x chord_frac x c / (b c)

nodes.title: cad
nodes.equation: read-outs of wing.py#layout(): spar cover, groove wall, groove depth fraction, pocket floor, hinge clearances

nodes.title: areas
nodes.equation: pass-through of the CAD bond surfaces

nodes.title: Wing subsystem mass (CAD estimate)
nodes.how: T-D1-WEIGH: weigh the cut core, the tube, the plugs, the tape used and the finished wing on a 1 g scale.

nodes.title: Wing subsystem CG x (CAD estimate)
nodes.how: Balance the finished bare wing (no pod, fins) on two knife edges along the span; read x from the LE.

nodes.title: Elevon area fraction as built (end gaps off)
nodes.how: Measure the four cut panels (span x chord) and divide by 1.15 x 0.32 m.

nodes.title: Minimum foam over the spar bore (S5010 at x 0.080, z +0.0066)
nodes.how: Cut a 20 mm slice off a test core with the slot: calipers from the bore to each skin.

nodes.title: Foam wall from the aft ESC-lead groove to the spar slot
nodes.how: Calipers on the first core before skinning (F2 CR-F2-04 asks 3 mm).

nodes.title: Deepest groove / local section thickness between x 0.06 and 0.10
nodes.how: C2 CR-C2-01 rule; depth gauge on the cut grooves.

nodes.title: Foam over the servo-pocket ceiling (pocket open below)
nodes.how: Depth gauge in the cut pocket; ceiling-to-upper-skin by subtraction from the local thickness.

nodes.title: Servo pocket bare-foam surface for the D6 frame
nodes.how: D6 shows the frame's bonded area; the pocket offers this much bare foam.

nodes.title: Spar-to-core bond area
nodes.how: Input to C2's slot-bond shear (CL-C2-SPAR-BOND-TAU); visual check of the fill along the slot before the cap goes on.

nodes.title: Elevon lower bevel clear of the core at full down
nodes.how: T-D1-THROW: hinge taped, panel to +25 deg on a protractor: a 0.5 mm feeler passes at the lower edge.

nodes.title: Elevon lower bevel clear of the core at full up
Foam over the elevon torque-tube groove
nodes.how: Calipers on a panel offcut with the groove routed; no crack on the upper face.

nodes.title: Pod recess aft end (4 mm of foam ahead of the spar)
nodes.how: Steel rule from the LE on the cut recess (CR-D2-04: 0.065).

nodes.title: Foam under the pod recess floor at its aft end
nodes.how: Depth gauge in the recess; subtract from the local thickness.

nodes.title: Wing surface outside the upper prop keep-outs (real surface, not bounding box)
nodes.how: On the first assembled wing: rule from each upper prop tip, turned by hand, to the upper skin near the LE at |y| 0.30-0.34; must exceed requirements.prop_clearance_min_m plus this gap.

nodes.title: Weigh every wing part
nodes.procedure: 1 g scale: core after cutting and pocketing, spar, 4 plugs, tape roll before / after skinning, each elevon, finished wing; knife-edge balance of the bare wing for CG x

nodes.title: First-core fit checks
nodes.procedure: Spar slides in the slot with 0.1-0.3 mm per side; both blocks drop into their pockets; anchor saddles seat on the spar; pod shell sits flat in the recess; grooves and pocket gauged against BUILD.md step checks

nodes.title: Elevon throw and clearance
nodes.procedure: Hinge taped, each panel moved by hand to +/-25 deg on a protractor; no contact with the core; feeler 0.5 mm
